listings.remarksConcat: Set beside Bainbridge Island’s coveted Rockaway Beach with sweeping water views, this one-of-a-kind residence is built around its scenery. Watch for porpoises and orcas passing through the Sound, or head down to paddle out to Blakely Rock on a calm afternoon. A private sauna and cold plunge add a spa-like retreat to daily life. The ADU studio and loft, accessible via third floor walkway or via the main courtyard,  offers independence and flexibility, ready to serve as a guest suite, hangout, rental, or home office. As evening falls, the Seattle skyline comes alive across the water, a view that changes with every hour of the day. Stellar views, thoughtful design, and a location that speaks for itself, this is ideal Bainbridge Island living.
